mapper.select: select o.*, p.product_name, b.username as buyer_name, s.username as seller_name from orders o left join product p on o.product_id = p.product_id left join sys_user b on o.buyer_id = b.user_id left join sys_user s on o.seller_id = s.user_id where o.order_id = #{orderId}
